تجتذبي (form VIII)
# تَجْتَذِبِي (tajtaḏibī) /tad͡ʒ.ta.ði.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# تُجْتَذَبِي (tujtaḏabī) /tud͡ʒ.ta.ða.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
